title: Missed Workout Streak Break
dataSources: Swim.com workouts (`swimcom:workout`), MySwimPro sessions (`myswimpro:session`), pool lap logs (`pool:lap`), and swim meet results (`swim:meet`).
app: Swim.com workout exports, MySwimPro session logs, pool lap counters, swim meet results, and interval pace trackers forwarded to Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=swimcom:workout
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as sessions by _time
| sort _time
| streamstats current=f last(_time) as prev_day
| eval gap_days=round((_time-prev_day)/86400,0)
| where gap_days>=7 AND sessions>0
| stats max(gap_days) as longest_break_days
description: Finds the longest gap of seven or more days between logged Swim.com workout days.
value: Long pool absences erode feel for the water; catching the break early makes returning less painful.
implementation: Run daily on Swim.com session counts and alert when the quiet gap exceeds your restart threshold.
visualization: Single-value tile for longest workout break in days.
grandmaExplanation: It spots the longest stretch you went without a logged swim workout.
